$comment: Areas of the website that are NEVER translated, and so are left out of the two
English catalogs when scripts/lib/website-english.mjs builds them.
An exclusion binds on BOTH sides or it binds on neither: an excluded key is not
required of any locale, not counted by coverage, and not checked by validate. A
locale that holds one anyway keeps it, inert, reported as an extra key.
`backendFiles` and `frontendNamespaces` are globs (`*` within one path segment,
`**` across segments). Backend files are matched relative to config/locales/.
`backendKeys` are dotted key prefixes, for an excluded area whose copy lives in
a file it shares with copy that IS translated.
Every entry says which area it belongs to. The areas are iHiD's list: admin,
bootcamp, courses, hiring, campaigns, challenges, maintaining, test, and dead
mailers. The PATTERNS under each area were matched by hand against website
main at 102577eb and need his review: an area with an empty list is one where
nothing at that commit obviously matched, never a claim that nothing exists.
